python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Individual income tax receipts (in thousands of dollars) for fiscal years 1929-1942
# From the table - "Individual" column under "Income and profit taxes"
data = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,
    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,
    1933: 352573,
    1934: 419509,
    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,
    1942: 3262800
}

# Convert to billions (divide by 1,000,000 since data is in thousands)
years = np.array(list(data.keys()))
receipts = np.array(list(data.values())) / 1_000_000  # convert to billions

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", receipts)

# OLS Regression
n = len(years)
sum_x = np.sum(years)
sum_y = np.sum(receipts)
sum_xy = np.sum(years * receipts)
sum_x2 = np.sum(years ** 2)

# Slope (beta)
slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x ** 2)
# Intercept
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nSlope: {slope:.6f}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f}")

# Rounded to 3 decimal places
print(f"\nRounded to 3 decimal places:")
print(f"Slope: {round(slope, 3)}")
print(f"Intercept: {round(intercept, 3)}")

# Output format [slope, intercept]
print(f"\nAnswer: [{round(slope, 3)}, {round(intercept, 3)}]")
EOF
